units.source_text: 各处都来吊丧，不知道是几时得悉的。

en.t: People came from every quarter to offer condolences, though no one knew when they had learned of the death.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将也闻知噩耗，非常吃惊，立刻遣使吊慰。

en.t: General Yugiri also heard the terrible news and was deeply shocked, so he immediately sent a messenger with condolences.

units.source_text: 源氏、前太政大臣，以及其他一切亲友，遣使致奠者甚多。

en.t: Genji, the former Grand Minister, and many other relatives and friends sent messengers with offerings of mourning.

units.source_text: 山中的朱雀院也送了一封十分恳挚的信来。

en.t: The Suzaku院 in the mountains also sent a deeply earnest letter.

units.source_text: 公主收到此信，方才抬起头来。

en.t: Only when the princess received this letter did she finally lift her head.

units.source_text: 但见信中有言：“我早就闻知你母病重，

en.t: In the letter she saw these words: "I had long heard that your mother was gravely ill,

units.source_text: 但她向来多病，我已见惯，以致疏忽，不曾遣使慰问。

en.t: but because she had always been sickly and I had grown used to it, I was careless and failed to send a messenger to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 你今遭此大故，诚属不幸之至。

en.t: Now that you have suffered this great bereavement, it is truly the height of misfortune.

units.source_text: 我推想你悲伤之状，不胜怜惜。

en.t: When I imagine the depth of your grief, I am filled with pity for you.

units.source_text: 务望省察人世无常之理，善自宽慰为要。”

en.t: I earnestly hope you will reflect on the impermanence of human life and take care to comfort yourself."

units.source_text: 公主两眼已经哭得不能见物，然而还是握笔奉复。

en.t: The princess had cried until her eyes could no longer see clearly, yet she still took up her brush and wrote a reply.

units.source_text: 老夫人生前常常嘱咐死后应如何殡葬，

en.t: During her lifetime, the old lady had often given instructions about how her funeral should be conducted after her death,

units.source_text: 故遵此遗命，今日即行出殡。

en.t: so in accordance with those final wishes, the funeral procession was to set out that very day.

units.source_text: 老夫人的侄儿大和守负责料理一切丧事。

en.t: The old lady's nephew, the Governor of Yamato, took charge of all the funeral arrangements.

units.source_text: 公主恋恋不舍，希望暂时多得瞻仰遗骸。

en.t: The princess could hardly bear to part from her and wished to gaze upon the remains a little longer.

units.source_text: 但此事不能照办，众人立刻准备出殡。

en.t: But this could not be granted, and everyone immediately prepared for the funeral procession.

units.source_text: 正在出发之际，夕雾大将来了。

en.t: Just as they were about to depart, General Yugiri arrived.
